Done. Summary:

- **`out/T4/solution.py`**: loads the three `model.safetensors` files with `safetensors.safe_open`, verifies (1) all three share the same 160 tensor names, (2) every non-MLP tensor is bit-identical across base/ft1/ft2 via `torch.equal`, aborting loudly (`ABORT: ...`, exit 1) on any mismatch. It then computes `out[X] = base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` in float32 for exactly the 48 MLP tensors (both deltas taken against the untouched `base`, avoiding the ordering hazard), copies the other 112 unchanged, asserts merged-count == 48 and total-count == 160, and writes `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
- **`out/T4/run.sh`**: thin wrapper invoking it with `.venv/bin/python`.
- Ran it once — succeeded first try. Independently verified the output: 160 keys, 112 non-MLP tensors bit-identical to base, sampled MLP tensor matches the formula exactly (max abs diff 0.0), dtype preserved as float32.
- **`out/T4/REPORT.md`**: filled in per `record-template.md`, noting the choice of a plain `safetensors`/`torch` script over `mergekit`'s task-arithmetic YAML (mergekit targets HF-Hub-style model dirs and adds indirection with no benefit here) and the ordering care point.

No `brainsurgery` package/CLI was used; only packages from `F-allowed.md`.
